Notion Meeting Notes Database queried for meetings created on or after 2026-07-21 — one result, "Personal Life Management System Walkthrough" (created 2026-07-28 today), a personal Notion-productivity-system demo unrelated to mining operations. 2. Out of scope for this KB, skipped. 3. No new meeting notes. 4. Key operational findings The August fiscal cycle's third straight negative survey-reconciliation day lands. `260728-INX-SUM.xlsx` reconciles Jul 27: trucks 21,142 BCM (ties this KB's own Jul 27 production total) against survey 13,322 BCM, a -7,820 BCM (-58.70%) gap — the sharpest single-day read of the new cycle so far, on "PC 2000 (262) and EXC 6020 (340) loading on heap + 5 meters area." MTD now stands at trucks 62,620 / survey 42,729 / -19,891 BCM (-31.76%). 5. Three days into the August cycle, every one has landed negative (-30.89%, -53.92%, -58.70%), and the survey rate now required to hit the monthly target for the rest of the cycle (21,524 BCM/day) already exceeds every daily survey figure posted this cycle. `August Distance report.xlsx`'s July (27) tab lands and cross-checks clean against Jul 27's already-compiled production figures — no discrepancy on the SHG/MG block split or the six-block waste breakdown. 6. Maaden's Mining II engineering team requested 2027 Budget Cycle data from JRAR on 5-Jul (KPI targets, 2022-Jun2026 historical performance, rated capacities, fleet renewal plans); JRAR delivered the completed workbook today. 7. This is the first multi-year historical trend and first forward-looking (2027) capacity plan in this KB. 8. Availability and utilization step up sharply for all three fleet types from 2025 onward (excavators 77.6%→91.8%→92.4% avail across 2024/2025/2026H1; trucks 89.1%→94.6%→95.1%; drills 71.9%→90.4%→90.4%). 9. The 2027 plan adds one new PC1250 excavator and stages full-life rebuilds across five 777-model dump trucks (DT-242 through DT-246), one per month March-August 2027, plus component-replacement months for four excavators and three drill rigs. The 2027 plan carries EX-123 at a flat 85.42% availability every month with no planned outage — it does not reflect the unit's actual 2026 collapse (95% May → 62% Jun → 31% Jul), which this KB has tracked since the 72nd pass. A data-quality flag: the workbook's excavator and truck MTBF figures repeat identically across four of five tracked years, reading as a placeholder rather than four independently measured years. Important References folder re-checked: still 28 files, no new content since the 72nd pass. Articles updated (all `Last updated` bumped to 2026-07-28): [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] (Day 3 section, MTD -31.76%, new Open Questions), [[daily-production-report]] (Jul 27 survey-landed update, Distance report cross-check), [[fleet-availability-utilization]] (2027 budget-cycle cross-reference, EX-123 plan-vs-actual mismatch flagged), [[workshop-maintenance-planning]] (2027 rebuild-schedule cross-reference). No content removed or renamed. Queried the Task Feedback Log's "All Feedback" view (33 rows, sorted Date Logged descending) — every row already shows Status "Processed," most recent Date Logged 2026-07-23 (the six rows the 72nd pass resolved). The EX-123 2027-plan mismatch and DT-281's unlabeled rebuild month are both logged as open questions in the Wiki instead. ---
